primary_aggregate_estimands: six-within-site equal-weight macro normalized RMSE: at each site average the three separate-seed RMSE values, divide by site capacity, then average the six sites
six-within-site equal-weight mean rank: rank the four variants by each site's three-seed mean RMSE using average ranks for exact ties, then average ranks across six sites
secondary_aggregate_estimands: the corresponding six-cross-site equal-weight macro normalized RMSE
the corresponding six-cross-site equal-weight mean rank
analysis_plan.paired_loss: at every task timestamp, average squared error across seeds 0,1,2 within each variant, then subtract removal loss from Full loss
analysis_plan.blocks: non-overlapping Monday-Sunday seven-calendar-day blocks with fixed 1970-01-05 Monday origin; retain all observations in each sampled block

bootstrap.rule: sample whole blocks with equal probability and replacement; each replicate divides sampled loss-difference sums by sampled counts

sign_flip.rule: independent whole-block sign flips with plus-one correction

analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm correction in two separate families: 6 sites x 3 Full-versus-removal tests = 18 within tests and 18 cross tests
analysis_plan.complete_reporting: report 12 tasks x 4 variants x 3 seeds; no task, seed, or variant may be removed using held-out performance
analysis_plan.interpretation: component effects are conditional on each task's locked Full configuration and are not independently retuned procedure comparisons; failure to reject is not evidence of equivalence

rmse_rule: compute RMSE separately per seed; average the three seed RMSE values
rank_rule: average ranks for exact ties; lower RMSE receives the lower rank
prediction_alignment: within each task all variants and seeds must have identical window_index, raw_target_row, timestamp, and y_true arrays
